items.statement: Correct full model identities and comparably defined molecular observables.
items.expected: Check source topology, formula, substituent positions, N-alkyl groups and actual charge/state against artifacts. Verify each reported property belongs to that object and condition. Truncating an ethyl to methyl or silently changing EPI1/EPI2 invalidates dependent conclusions. Conformer IDs must not be confused with distinct chemical species.

items.statement: Reproducible polarity findings rather than copied source dipoles.
items.expected: Recompute the chosen polarity quantity from native outputs/analysis, checking units, definitions and method appropriateness. Accept a suitable alternative to mu or <mu²> when its relation to the stated question is justified. A single evaluated geometry earns only its demonstrated scope; publication dipoles, attractive ESP pictures or unverified statements alone earn no numerical finding credit.

items.statement: Evidence that establishes the explanation and conditions of the substitution effect.
items.expected: Assess whether the chosen evidence distinguishes the claimed source of the molecular difference and tests any asserted generality. If claiming a hydrogen-bond cause, inspect actual geometry/electronic or spectroscopic evidence and pertinent competing changes; no specific OH rotation or frozen backbone is mandatory. If a conformational counterexample invalidates a universal claim, reward it in proportion to verified scope. Neither lower polarity nor any named mechanism is required.

items.statement: Reliability sufficient for single-structure or population claims.
items.expected: Check stationary-point/curvature evidence where minima are claimed. For population claims inspect distinct basins, energy/free-energy conventions, temperature, weights and uncertainty; repeated collapsed searches are not degeneracy. Do not equate <|mu|> with <mu²> or average lab-frame dipoles as an isotropic bulk response. For non-ensemble claims require the alternative relevant uncertainty evidence, not unused ensemble tests. Do not score a fixed arbitrary conformer number or low-frequency recipe.
